import json
def read_pink(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(''.join('#' if a[52+r][15+c*7+j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(5)) for r in range(5)) for c in range(5))
# current pos of cursor: find W nodes
def cursor(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>=6:
            b=n['boundary']
            cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cols)>=14 and max(cols)<=48 and min([p[0] for p in b])>=47:
                return (min(cols)+max(cols))//2
    return None
print("cursor col now:", cursor(current_frame))
# cycle at each position: from position p, press UP 7 times, record
pos=0
seq=[]
p0=read_pink(current_frame)
print("start:", [x[0] for x in p0])
for i in range(7):
    action(['UP'])
    seq.append(read_pink(current_frame))
# now back at start
print("after 7 UPs back to start:", read_pink(current_frame)==p0)
for i in range(5):
    print("pos",i,"cycle:", [''.join(''.join(r) for r in seq[k][i]) for k in range(7)])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
